description: React component for managing team membership roles in the Mattermost admin console, including role changes and removal from team.

methods.name: makeTeamAdmin
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the user's role to team admin and handles errors.

methods.name: makeMember
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the user's role to team member and handles errors.

methods.name: removeFromTeam
methods.description: Removes the user from the team.
